candidate.definition_en: To voluntarily give up or let go of something.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني تتنازل عن حاجة أو تسيبها بمزاجك.. زي السلطة أو حق ليك

senses.definition_en: To voluntarily give up power, control, or a legal claim.
senses.definition_ar: التنازل طوعًا عن سلطة أو سيطرة أو حق رسمي
examples: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
She refused to relinquish her claim to the property.

senses.definition_en: To physically let go of something held.
senses.definition_ar: إفلات شيء مقبوض عليه أو تركه ماديًا
examples: He had to relinquish his grip on the railing to jump safely.
He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
She refused to relinquish her claim to the property.
He had to relinquish his grip on the railing to jump safely.
candidate.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Release'.. إنك تسيب الحاجة وتتخلى عنها
